1.41.3 - Public advertiser media kit

  • NEW inc/advertise.php adds /advertise/ and [nadlan_advertise]: a public sales surface for professionals, project advertisers, and promoted property owners.
  • Packages now state artifact, duration, reporting promise, honest current metrics, and direct WooCommerce CTAs for products 476/477/489/490.
  • The page links paid checkout to the Advertiser Center/Studio flow and publishes the policies: no traffic guarantees in Phase 0, fixed campaign duration, sponsored-content disclosure, and make-good for missed placement.

1.41.2 - Advertiser Center + paid-tier order bridge

  • NEW inc/advertiser-center.php adds /advertiser-center/ and /advertiser-dashboard/: logged-in advertisers see owned cards/projects/properties, completion score, views, inquiries, reviews, recent orders, Studio edit/upload links, and upgrade paths.
  • NEW inc/advertiser-orders.php preserves card_id through WooCommerce checkout and activates the existing paid_tier meta on woocommerce_payment_complete: 476->pro, 477->premier, 489->project premier, 490->property pro.
  • Paid card metadata is intentionally limited to campaign_end, paid_order_id, and paid_product_id; no parallel campaign_status is introduced.
  • Daily downgrade cron returns expired pro/premier one-time campaigns to free so a single payment cannot become permanent paid placement.
  • WooCommerce order-received and My Account now point paid products 476/477/489/490 to the Advertiser Center so advertisers know the next step immediately after checkout.
  • Research and reusable monetization standard captured in docs/2026-06-03-advertiser-monetization-research-and-center.md and skills/advertiser-monetization-system.md.

1.41.1 â€” CRITICAL FIX: /projects/ and /professionals/ were blank

  • Root cause: sponsored-spot.php (v1.40.0) used ob_start() on template_redirect and called nadlan_ss_card() â€” which itself used ob_start/ob_get_clean â€” from inside that output-buffer handler. PHP forbids nested output buffering in an ob handler â†’ fatal â†’ BLANK PAGE on every directory-rendered archive (both /professionals/ and /projects/) since v1.40.0. Rewrote sponsored-spot with ZERO output buffering: ob-free card builder + injection via a new nadlan_dir_cards_html filter (server) + safe rest_post_dispatch (AJAX). Both archives render again.

Owner of a claimed nadlan_professional/project/property card can: drag-drop image upload, edit description with AI assist (5 modes via Claude Haiku), pick exact location on a Leaflet+OpenStreetMap map (zero-cost, no Google bill), add social links (FB/IG/TikTok/YT), embed YouTube/Vimeo video, edit type-specific fields. Six REST endpoints (auth: owner-only).
  • Public profile pages now render social pills + video embed (inc/profile-extras.php).
  • Studio auto-flips data_quality=enriched once a card has 80+ char description + 1+ photo (helps schema noindex guard).
  • User manual + design rationale in skills/user-manual-advertiser.md.

1.40.2 â€” HOMEPAGE 502 HOTFIX

  • Fixes the homepage 502 introduced by v1.40.0 social-proof block. The "recently claimed" + "popular this week" queries did meta_value_num sorts over 2,700-row postmeta with no index â†’ PHP-FPM timeout â†’ nginx 502 on the homepage only (admin + archives kept working). Hotfix: (a) 1h transient cache so it is one DB hit per hour from the second visitor, (b) cheap EXISTS probes that SKIP the heavy queries when no verified claims / no view counts exist (true today; turns on automatically when real data lands).
